what.text: This page follows refugees from Türkiye living in Iraq, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3537 Turkish refugees in Iraq, 2.4% of all refugees from Türkiye.
Germany hosts the most Turkish refugees, followed by France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey with the PKK from 1988 to 2013 and from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2017 and over the government in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 1380 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 16832, at the end of 2006; the main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Iraq.
These are year-end totals for Iraq only, reported to UNHCR.
